messages:
elena: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: hiring and org changes. Wanted to capture a few clarifications folks asked for.

sam: Thanks! First: is the company doing any forced moves or layoffs as part of this realignment?

elena: No forced moves or layoffs. We're doing an internal redeployment period (voluntary) and will offer transition support for anyone who opts into a new role.

morgan: Are contractors going to be used to fill short-term gaps while we rearrange teams?

elena: Yes, we expect limited contractor usage for Q2 fixed-term work (mainly infra burst capacity). Any contractor req needs sign-off from Finance + Hiring Ops.

dana: For managers: when you get approved headcount changes, what wording should we use in team updates?

people-ops: Suggested short blurb coming to #people-ops in 30m. Main points: reason for change, what stays the same, and where to go with questions. Keep it 2-3 sentences.

li: Will compensation bands change for anyone moving into the merged teams? Concern about leveling parity.

elena: No retroactive comp changes. Going forward we'll align leveling frameworks across teams; any band adjustments are handled via regular comp cycle. If someone thinks their level is incorrect after mapping, raise it with your manager + People Ops.

recruiting-bot: New public tracker for reqs: https://recruiting.redwood.ai/trackers/q2-reorg (updated hourly) :mag: :link:

sam: Nice. How do we avoid double-interviewing candidates between two teams that are merging?

elena: Recruiting will flag overlapping reqs and pause duplicate outreach. If a candidate appears in two pipelines, recruiting will surface options and coordinate a single loop.

morgan: Any update on hiring priorities? Product teams need to know whether to defer new feature work.

elena: Priorities for the next 8 weeks: Serving/runtime infra, Observability (cost & traces), and Core Reliability. Smaller feature teams should gate big new initiatives until hiring plans are confirmed.

dana: Is there a formal matching process for people who want to switch to the new Serving org?

elena: Yes 1-day voluntary matching window will open next Monday. Managers will get a packet with role descriptions and timelines. Participation is opt-in.

people-ops: Transition benefits: 2 weeks of overlap pay for anyone who covers both old and new responsibilities during mapping; career coaching slots will be available.

li: Who owns oncall during the handover? I'm worried about gaps.

elena: Eng-sre + the temporary transition roster will own oncall for 6 weeks. We'll post the roster in #eng-oncall and ping people two weeks before any change.

sam: Will there be an FAQ doc or a living doc to track these changes?

elena: Yes, FAQ + timeline uploaded to the handbook: https://handbook.redwood.ai/reorg-q2-2026. We'll keep it updated and add an "open questions" section.

morgan: Thanks 1ot of clarity. Can recruiting tag managers on reqs so we can follow progress?

elena: Recruiting will @mention hiring managers on each req and publish weekly status digests. Expect the first digest on Monday AM.

dana: Small ask: can we get a one-pager for product managers about which hires are go/no-go this quarter?

elena: Yes, PM-one-pager will be posted with the hiring tracker.
